label: Aristotle, Metaphysics VIII.6, 1045a29–33…: Within the proximate-matter/form reply, Aristotle says…
interpretation: Prose source reading retaining both the conditional mover exception and generation qualification. This challenges a further-tie explanation of this unity; it does not say a generated whole is uncaused, deny every dependence of its being, or supply an independently verified sufficient explanation of existence.
